hook.text: You snapped 4 times today. Not once did you pause for Allah.

end.text: You snapped 4 times today. Not once did you pause for Allah.
end.gold: Today, before Maghrib: make wudu, then say sorry.

captions: The traffic. The horn. Your hands tight on the wheel.
Earlier, your mother called. You cut her off.
Your colleague. The cashier. The driver behind you.
Every word felt right. Then that heavy silence.
Home. Your mother on the sofa. It rises again.
This time, you stop. Cold water. Wudu.
You sit next to her. “I'm sorry, Mama.”

post.caption:
You snapped 4 times today. Not once did you pause for Allah. 🚗

The traffic. Your mother on the phone. The cashier. Every word felt right — for three seconds.

“Indeed, Allah is with the patient.” (2:153)

Today, before Maghrib: make wudu, then say sorry. 💧
